title: ビジネス統計学Ⅱ
subtitle: Business Statistics II
educationalGoal: This course deals with statistical and quantitative analysis from a management techniques perspective. Students will learn to: (1)learn the techniques to select, process, and extract necessary information from various information sources. (2)understand statistical data analysis methods.
advice: This is an introductory course in statistical analysis. Participants will learn various theoretical foundations of statistical analysis, and acquire practical business skills in processing, filtering, and extracting information using Microsoft Excel. We will cover the following topics: 1)Hypothesis testing 2)Population intercept ,population slope 3)Estimated regression relationship Students are required to bring their laptop computer, with Microsoft Excel installed, to every class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the average and differences between two sets of data.
Be able to understand the average and differences between multiple sets of data.
Be able to understand positive and negative relationships between sets of data.
Be able to understand the causal relationships between multiple factors and outcomes.
